title: US stocks today: Nasdaq rebounds as chipmakers rally, Apple slides ahead of US midterm results - The Economic Times
text:
US stocks ended mixed as the Nasdaq rebounded on gains in chipmakers and AI linked heavyweights ahead of the midterm election results. Nvidia and Micron advanced, while Apple slipped over concerns about rising memory chip costs and holiday quarter margins. Investors also assessed AI spending concerns and the outlook for technology stocks.
